title: Trophic structure of the eastern Chukchi Sea: An updated mass balance food web model
authors: George A. Whitehouse; Kerim Y. Aydin
loadability_evidence: No native EwE database loaded; public documentation and tables require reconstruction and validation before use.
documentation_evidence: 175-page NOAA report updates baseline inputs from Arctic Eis 2012 surveys and provides detailed parameterization.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: Downloaded NOAA report inspected: Table2 PDF pages25–26 provides57-group B,P/B,Q/B,EE,GE,U/Q and removals (beluga B0.01159,P/B0.11,Q/B14.50). AppendixTableA1 begins PDF179, numerical prey/predator matrix inspected PDF180, e.g. beluga0.5544 pelagic forage fish. No native EwE load attempted. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Eastern Chukchi continental shelf; excludes western Chukchi and northern Bering portions of LME.
coverage_note: Eastern Chukchi continental shelf; excludes western Chukchi and northern Bering portions of LME.
